analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($134.10) vs SMA5 ($141.35)/SMA20 ($148.47)/SMA50 ($134.50): Below short/mid-term trends, indicating weak long-term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($123.96)/SMA200 ($131.27): Approaching long-term support, potential for trend reversal.
· 52-week position (45.5%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (54.5 → 42.0): Entering oversold territory, downward momentum continues.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.9811 → -2.4751): Weakness persists, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $137.53): Approaching lower band, band width at 14.74% indicates expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($133.40): Based on Pivot S1 ($124.84) and SMA100 ($123.96).
· Swing Resistance ($135.96): Based on SMA50 ($134.50) and Pivot ($141.86).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low / Lower High / Consolidation): 5-day low $132.60, 20-day low $132.60, indicating consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.99x 5-day average): Significant increase, boosting confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Observe and await confirmation of recovery above support at $133.40.
